reason: AAPL at 305.26 sits just above a repeatedly defended 300-302 shelf but below its falling 10-EMA (310.24), 50-SMA (309.28) and VWMA (315.81), with MACD still negative at -2.19 despite a slightly narrower histogram. The tape is unconfirmed and does not justify adding, especially after the prior 8/5 Overweight lesson to wait for confirmation rather than buy mid-chop. Conversely, selling the residual near support is premature: Q3 revenue grew 16.4% to $109.4B, diluted EPS rose 28.7% to $2.02, nine-month operating cash flow was $117.0B and net cash remains strong, while the rising 200-SMA (280.30) is well below spot. News is mixed: Jefferies cut its target on AI/product momentum and valuation, while Apple's AI-Siri publisher talks and robust earnings support the franchise. With price trapped between support and overhead supply, HOLD the prior reduced target; require a close above 310-312 or a high-volume reclaim of 315.8 to add, and a decisive close below 300/294 to reduce further.
risks: Short-term downtrend: price below 10-EMA, 50-SMA and VWMA with lower highs since 8/7; a break of 300-302 could open 293.5 and then the 200-SMA near 280.
Valuation and sentiment risk: Jefferies price-target cut questions premium valuation and AI/product momentum; DCF commentary suggests shares are priced richly.
Margin risk: Q3 gross margin 50.06% may be near a cyclical peak; memory/component cost inflation, CXMT sourcing and tariffs could pressure future margins.

Balance-sheet disclosure gaps: inventory rose 94% to $11.1B with raw materials +260%, net intangibles jumped to $25.4B and other noncurrent liabilities rose to $55.1B without clear footnote explanation.
Deferred revenue growth (+8.8%) lagged revenue growth (+16.2%), a possible Services/booking deceleration signal.
Leadership, policy and competitive risks: reported executive changes, Trump-era policy/tariff challenges, and Google Pixel/Gemini competition.

Data limitations: no insider transactions, no options chain, no consensus estimates or valuation multiples; news sample is only 20 of 204 eligible records; price snapshot alignment was not fully reproduced, so position sizing and targets are technical rather than valuation-derived.
